name: Love Fetish ~Sanshamendan Hen~
original_name: らぶフェチ　～三者面談編～
source:
Main character has a loving girlfriend, but despite all his ambition he does not know how to move forward with their relations. He asks for a consultation and finds a whole world in manipulating women around him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角有一名深愛自己的成年女友，但無論多麼渴望推進關係，他都不知道該怎麼做。他前去請教別人，由此發現了一個一整個能操弄身邊女性的世界。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
